home.title: Creative Activities mō ngā kaitiaki katoa
home.description: Ngā mahi auaha koreutu mō ngā kaitiaki katoa: ngā mahi ringa, ngā mea mā ngā tamariki, ngā mahi hei mahi ngātahi me ngā whakaaro auaha mārie.
home.eyebrow: Koreutu · Kāore he pānui hokohoko · Kāore he rēhita · Kāore he taima, he māka rānei
home.lede: Kimihia tētahi mahi e tika ana mō te tangata, mō te wā, me ngā mea kei a koe. Ngā mahi ringa ngāwari, ngā toi a ngā tamariki, ngā mahi hei mahi ngātahi me ngā whakaaro auaha mārie, me ngā momo ngāwari ake me tētahi kāri hei tā. Whakamutua ina hiahia koe.
facts: Ka mahi i runga waea, papa rorohiko, rorohiko hoki
He whakaahua nui e wātea tonu ana ki te kitea
Whakamutua i ngā wā katoa; kāore he mea hei hinganga
home.heroApp: He taupānga koreutu anō mō te iPhone, iPad me te Android, hei whakamahi i ō ake whakaahua whānau
home.albumNote: “E rua ngā whakaahua o te kapu tī, e tū tahi ana.”
home.gamesEyebrow: Tākaro i roto i tō pūtirotiro
home.gamesTitle: Ngā kēmu ka taea te tākaro ināianei tonu
home.gamesLede: He mārie, he hāngai ki te hunga pakeke, he tere te tīmata o ia kēmu. Kōwhiria tētahi, noho taha ki te taha, ā, me whakawhitiwhiti ki te pā atu.

steps.title: Kōwhiria he kaupapa e mōhiotia ana
steps.text: He whakaahua o ngā kapu tī, ngā kāriki, ngā mōkai me ngā kaipuke rā. Kāore he tuhinga, he ture rānei hei ako i te tuatahi.

steps.title: E noho taha ki te taha
steps.text: Tukua mā te tangata e pā atu. Kōrerohia ngā whakaahua. Ki te kore e ōrite, he tatari noa iho mō te pānga mai e whai ake nei.

steps.title: Whakamutua i te wā e pai tonu ana te noho
steps.text: He mahi oti pai tonu te kēmu kotahi. Kei te mata tonu te kōwhiringa “Kua mutu mō tēnei wā”.

home.stageEyebrow: I tua atu i te mata rorohiko
home.stageTitle: He whakaaro mahi mō ia wāhanga o te oranga
home.stageLede: He waiata, he mahi o ia rā, he maumahara ngātahi me ngā wā marie ā-rongo, he mea whakarite kia hāngai ki te āhua e pai ana ināianei.

stages.title: Wāhanga moata
stages.text: Haere tonu ngā mahi e pai ana ki a rātou, me ētahi whakarerekētanga iti: ngā runaruna, ngā haerenga poto, ngā kēmu kupu me te whakamahere tahi.
stages.label: He whakaaro mō te wāhanga moata

stages.title: Wāhanga waenga
stages.text: He mahi māmā, he mea mōhio kua wehea kia whai wāhanga iti: te kopa kākahu, te whakariterite taonga, te waiata, ngā kēmu whakaahua me ngā hīkoi poto.
stages.label: He whakaaro mō te wāhanga waenga

stages.title: Wāhanga whakamutunga
stages.text: He whakamarie me te hononga mā te pā o te ringa, te reo me te titiro: te panipani ringa, ngā waiata tino pai, ngā whakaahua tawhito me te noho tahi noa.
stages.label: He whakaaro mō te wāhanga whakamutunga

home.specificHtml: E rapu ana koe i tētahi mea motuhake? Whakamātauria ngā mahi me ngā tākaro mō te Alzheimer's, ngā pazela me ngā tākaro tēpu, ngā tākaro kōrero or ngā pazela.
home.approachTitle: Tētahi mahi tahi, ehara i te whakamātautau
home.approachLede: He maha ngā “tākaro hinengaro” e hangaia ana ki te tere, ngā kaute me ngā raupapa. Mō tētahi tangata e ngenge ana, e mate ana, e noho ana rānei me te mate wareware, ka rite pea tērā ki te whakamātautau. Ko te mea rerekē tā mātou i hanga ai.
home.approachLink: He aha i pēnei ai tā mātou hoahoa

principles.title: Kāore he mea e hinga ai
principles.text: Kāore he karaka, he māka, he whakahaere oranga, he tūnga whakamutunga rānei. Ko te whakaahua rerekē he okiokinga noa, ehara i te hapa.

principles.title: Ka noho tuwhera tonu ngā whakaahua
principles.text: He mōhio ki te whakaahua, kaua ko te pīkau mahara. Ka tīmata te whakatōpū whakaahua e anga whakarunga ana, nō reira kāore he mea hei maumahara ake.

principles.title: Hāngai ana ki te hunga pakeke, he whakaute
principles.text: He reo mahana, he māmā, me ngā whakaahua tūturu o te ao. Kāore rawa he pikitia tamariki, he kōrero kōhungahunga rānei.

principles.title: He tūmataiti mai i te orokohanganga
principles.text: Kāore he pūkete, he pānui hokohoko rānei. E kore rawa ō whakaahua e wehe atu i tō pūrere.

home.researchTitle: Te hauora roro: ngā kōrero tūturu mai i te rangahau
home.researchText: Ka taea rānei te ārai i te mate wareware? He āwhina rānei tā ngā kēmu roro? Pēhea te nohopuku, te kai, te moe me te rongo tangi? He whakautu māmā me ōna putake kōrero, tae atu ki ngā wāhi e ngoikore tonu ana ngā taunakitanga.
home.appTitle: Creative Activities i runga i te iPhone, iPad me te Android
home.appText: Ka mahi noa te taupānga koreutu ahakoa kāore he hononga ipurangi, ā, ka taea te whakamahi i ngā whakaahua whānau e kōwhiria ana e koe, e pupuritia ana hei tārua ki tō pūrere anake. He hoahoa mārie anō hoki: e whā ngā tāpa nunui, kāore he taima, kāore he māka.

faq.q: He aha ngā tākaro pai mō ngā pakeke?
faq.a: He ngāwari, he mōhio ngā tākaro pai, kāore he taumahatanga: ngā whakaahua nui hei whakatairite, te whakarōpū, ngā pazela ngāwari, te whakaoti i ngā whakataukī mōhio, te tā tae, te bingo whakaahua me ngā kāri kōrero. He pai ēnei mō te maha o ngā pakeke, tae atu ki ngā tāngata e noho ana me te mate wareware. Ko te whiringa pai ko tērā e pai ana ki te tangata i tēnei rā. Kia mahara ki te karo i ngā tikanga wā, ngā piro me ngā mea e rite ana ki te whakamātautau.

Āe. He kore utu ngā kēmu me ngā rauemi tā katoa i runga i a Creative Activities, kāore he pūkete hei hanga, he whakauru ingoa, he tikiake rānei. Ka rere tonu ngā kēmu i roto i te pūtirotiro paetukutuku i runga waea, papa rorohiko, rorohiko rānei.

faq.q: Ka ārai rānei ngā kēmu roro i te mate wareware?
faq.a: Kāore he tākaro kua whakaatuhia kia ārai i te mate wareware, ā, kāore a Creative Activities e kii ana ka rongoā, ka ārai rānei i tētahi mea. Ko ā mātou tākaro mō te ngahau me te wā tahi, ā, kāore tētahi whārangi mahi e kii ana i tētahi kerēme hauora.

faq.q: He pai ēnei kēmu mō te tangata whai mate Alzheimer?
faq.a: Āe. Ko te mate Alzheimer te tino take matua o te mate wareware, ā, i hangaia ngā kēmu mō tēnei kaupapa: he whakaahua nui e tūwhera tonu ana, he torutoru noa ngā kōwhiringa, ā, kāore he mea hei maumahara, hei hē rānei. Ko te whakataurite, te kōmaka, me te whakaoti i ngā kōrero matawhānui e whirinaki ana ki ngā mātauranga o mua, kaua ki te ako i ngā mea hou.

faq.q: Ka taea e te tangata kei te wāhanga tōmuri o te mate wareware te whakamahi i ēnei ngohe?
faq.a: I te nuinga o te wā, āe, mēnā he tangata kei tōna taha. Me tīmata ki te Rapua te mea ōrite me ngā whakaahua e rua, ngā Takirua whakaahua me ngā tāera e whā, he whārangi whakakikī tae, he wā whakatā mārie rānei hei whakangā manawa. Kia poto noa, whāia tā rātou e hiahia ai, ā, me mutu tonu ina kua ranea ki a rātou.

Kāore he pūkete, kāore hoki he pānuitanga kei tēnei paetukutuku. Ka whakamahi mātou i a Google Analytics kia mārama ai he aha ngā whārangi e tirohia ana. Ko ngā whakaahua ka kōwhiria e koe mō ngā Takirua whakaahua ka whakaaturia anake i roto i tō pūtirotiro, ā, e kore rawa e tukuna atu ki waho.

faq.q: Ko wai kei te hanga i a Creative Activities?
faq.a: He tīma iti a Creative Activities e hanga ana i ngā mahi auaha mārie, pakeke mō ngā kaitiaki katoa, ki te paetukutuku me te taupānga koreutu. Ehara mātou i ngā tohunga hauora, ā, kāore he tohutohu hauora i konei.

appCta.title: Mauria ēnei kēmu ki a koe
appCta.text: Te taupānga kore utu a Creative Activities mō te iPhone, iPad me te Android: he tāera whakaahua nui, he kēmu me āu ake whakaahua whānau, me ngā kōpaki whakaahua e mahi ana ahakoa kāore he Wi‑Fi. Kāore he pūkete, he pānuitanga, he matawā, he māka rānei.

activities.label: Aratohu mahi
activities.title: Ngā Aratohu Mahi
activities.seo: Ngā Aratohu Mahi: Whakaaro, Taputapu Toi me ngā Huarahi Tīmata
activities.description: Ngā aratohu mārama mō ngā mahi auaha ka taea e koe te mahi tahi me tētahi: ngā whakaaro ngāwari, ngā taputapu toi ki te utu iti, ngā toi ngātahi, ngā reta, ngā mahara, me te whakamārama i te toi rongoā.
activities.lede: Ngā aratohu poto, whaihua mō te whiri me te tīmata i tētahi mahi me tētahi, ahakoa tōna pakeke, tōna kaha rānei.

crafts.label: Ngā mahi ringa
crafts.title: Ngā Mahi Ringa mō ngā Pakeke Katoa
crafts.seo: Ngā Mahi Ringa Ngāwari mō ngā Pakeke Katoa, me ngā Momo Ngāwari Ake
crafts.description: Ngā mahi ringa ngāwari mō ngā pakeke, ngā tamariki me ngā whānau: pepa, tā tae, ngā mahi para whakamahia me ngā mahi o ia wā, me ngā momo ngāwari ake mō te pupuri me te noho, me te kore e hiahia he pūkenga motuhake.
crafts.lede: Ngā mahi ringa e tīmata ana i ngā mea kei te nuinga o ngā whare, ia mahi me tōna momo ngāwari ake, kia taea e te katoa te hanga tētahi mea.

kids.label: Tamariki
kids.title: Ngā Mahi Auaha mō ngā Tamariki
kids.seo: Ngā Mahi Auaha mō ngā Tamariki: Toi, Ngā Rongo me te Mārie
kids.description: Ngā mahi auaha mō ngā tamariki: toi o ngā tamariki iti, toi tukanga, tākaro ā-rongo, ngā mahi rā ua me ngā whakaaro whakamārie, me ngā kōrero haumaru me ngā momo mō ngā hiahia ā-rongo.
kids.lede: Ngā whakaaro toi me te tākaro mō ngā tamariki o ngā pakeke me ngā hiahia rerekē, me ngā kōrero haumaru mārama me tētahi pakeke e tata ana.

together.label: Ngātahi
together.title: Ngā Mahi Hei Mahi Ngātahi
together.seo: Ngā Mahi Hei Mahi Ngātahi, i waenga i ngā Whakatipuranga
together.description: Ngā mahi mō ngā whakatipuranga e rua neke atu: ngā tākaro kōrero, pazela, wā ki waho, ngā mahi ringa mō ngā kaumātua me ngā mokopuna, me ngā huarahi ki te noho tata ahakoa tawhiti.
together.lede: Ngā whakaaro mō te tiritiri i te wā me tētahi mātua, kaumātua, tamaiti, hoa rānei, i te kāinga, ki waho, i tētahi toronga, ahakoa tawhiti.

creative-calm.label: Mārie auaha
creative-calm.title: Mārie Auaha
creative-calm.seo: Mārie Auaha: Ngā Toi Whakangāwari me ngā Mahi hei Whakatā
creative-calm.description: Ngā mahi auaha whakangāwari mō ngā pakeke me ngā kaitiaki: toi whakaaro, tuhi pukapuka, waiata, wā rongo me ngā ahiahi mārie. He mahi auaha, ehara i te rongoā.
creative-calm.lede: Ngā huarahi ngāwari ki te whakatā me te pene, te whārangi, te waiata rānei. He mahi auaha ēnei, ehara i te rongoā, ā, kāore e hiahia he pūkenga.

caregiving.label: Te tiaki hunga mate wareware
caregiving.title: Te tiaki tētahi e mate ana i te wareware
caregiving.seo: Te tiaki tētahi e mate ana i te wareware: ngā mahi me te āwhina
caregiving.description: He aratohu mā ngā whānau e tiaki ana i tētahi e mate ana i te wareware: me pēhea te tākaro tahi, me te aha ina kī mai rātou kāore, me te kimi āwhina pono i muri i te whakamaaramatanga.
caregiving.lede: He āwhina ā-mahi mā ngā whānau e tiaki ana i tētahi e noho ana me te wareware, me te wāhi ka taea ai te tahuri mō ngā tohutohu hauora me te tiaki.

brain-health.label: Hauora roro
brain-health.title: Hauora Roro: Tā ngā Rangahau e Kī Ana
brain-health.seo: Hauora Roro me te Mōrearea o te Mate Wareware: Tā ngā Rangahau e Kī Ana
brain-health.description: Ka taea rānei te ārai i te mate wareware? He aratohu pono, whai puna kōrero mō ngā take mōrearea o te mate wareware, ngā kēmu roro, te nohopuku, te kai, te korikori tinana, te moe, te rongo me ngā tohu tōmua.
brain-health.lede: He whakamārama māmā mō ngā mea e kitea ana e ngā rangahau nunui mō te whakaheke i te mōrearea o te mate wareware, tae atu ki ngā wāhi e ngoikore ana, e rangirua ana rānei ngā taunakitanga. He mōhiohio whānui noa, ehara i te tohutohu rongoā.

guide.staleLink: Pānuitia te whārangi Pākehā o nāianei

healthNotice.title: He mōhiohio whānui, ehara i te tohutohu rongoā
healthNotice.textHtml: E whakarāpopoto ana tēnei whārangi i ngā rangahau kua whakaputaina hei painga mō ngā whānau. E kore e taea te tohutohu he aha te mea tika mā tētahi tangata kotahi. Kōrero ki tētahi tākuta i mua i te whakarerekē i te kai, te korikori tinana, te moe, ngā rongoā, ngā tāpiringa kai rānei. Mō te pōhēhē whakarere, ētahi atu huringa ohorere rānei, me rapu tonu i te āwhina hauora. Pānuitia tā mātou pānui mōhiohio hauora.

about.lede: Ka hanga a Creative Activities i ngā mahi pakupaku, pakeke e ngahau ai ngā tāngata e rua i te taha o tētahi atu, ahakoa ko tētahi e tiaki ana i tētahi atu, ko rātou anake e hiahia ana ki te noho tahi.
about.bodyHtml:
Mō wai tēnei

Mō te katoa e tiaki ana i tētahi: he mātua, he kaumātua, he tamaiti, he hoa rangatira, he hoa, he tangata e noho ana me te wareware. Ka taea e ngā whānau, ngā pakeke me ngā kaimahi mahi katoa te whakamahi i ngā whārangi ōrite.

Ā mātou whakapono

Ko te take o te mahi ko te wā tonu: he kōrerorero, he kata, te ngākau nui o te whakapiri i ngā whakaahua e rua, te noho tata noa iho rānei. Ehara i te mea ki te ine i tētahi, ki te tohe kia haere atu, ki te whakaatu rānei i tētahi mea.

He maha ngā taupānga whakangungu roro i hangaia mai i te tere, i ngā pae, i ngā rarangi wiki me ngā taumata. Mō tētahi e ngenge ana, e mate ana, e noho ana rānei me te wareware, he pērā te āhua he whakamātautau e kore e taea te pass. I hangaia e mātou te rerekē, ā, e here ana mātou ki ēnei ture:

  • Kāore he mea hei hinga. Kāore he karaka, he pae, he nekehanga kaute, he ora, he rarangi wiki, he pūhihi, he tātaitanga whakahoki i runga i tētahi mata.
  • Te mōhio ki te whakaahua, ehara i te maumahara. Ka noho tonu ngā whakaahua ina tīmata. Ka whakaaro ngā whakaaraara ki te kōrerorero, kāore e whakamātau i ngā ingoa, i ngā maumahara rānei.
  • Nui, māmā, pūmau. He kupu nui, he whakaahua nui, he rerekētanga kaha, he mana kia tū tonu ngā whakahaere ki te wāhi kotahi.
  • Te mana pakeke. He whakaahua o te ao tūturu, he kupu māmā, mahana. Kāore he kātūni, he whakanui waiata, he utu emoji.
  • He huarahi māmā mawhiti. Kei te whakaatu tonu te “Kua mutu mō tēnei wā”. He pai te mutu waenganui.
  • Muna tonu tō motuhake. Kāore he pūkete, he panuku. Ka noho ngā whakaahua e kōwhiria ana e koe ki tō pūkoro.

Ā mātou kerēme kāore

He mō te harikoa me te whakapiri ā mātou tākaro me ā mātou mahi. Kāore e whakatau, e whakamātau, e ine, e rongoā, e whakaroa, e aukati i te wareware me te mate Alzheimer, ā, kāore tētahi e tika kia kōwhiri i a rātou mō taua take. Ina tuhi mātou mō ngā rangahau hauora, ka kī mārama mātou ina pakaru te taunaki, ā, kāore mātou e hono atu ki ā mātou ake mahi.

Ko wai mātou

He kāhui motuhake iti a Creative Activities. Ehara mātou i te kaimātai rongoā. Ka tuhia ā mātou aratohu mai i ngā tohutohu kua whakaputaina e ngā whakahaere pēnei i te National Institute on Aging me te Alzheimer’s Association, ā, kei ia aratohu ngā puna katoa. Pānuitia te āhua o tā mātou tuhi me tā mātou tirotiro i ā mātou whārangi.

Korerohia mai he aha ka āwhina

He pai ki a mātou te rongo he aha e pai ana mā koe, he aha e kore ai, ina hoki mai i ngā tāngata e noho ana me te wareware, i ngā kaitiaki whānau me ngā kaimahi mahi. Imeera ki {email}.

editorial.title: Te Tuhituhi me te Tirotiro i ā Mātou Whārangi
editorial.description: Te āhua o te rangahau, te tuhi, te kimi puna me te whakahou a Creative Activities i ā mātou whārangi mahi me hauora, me ngā mea e kore rawa e tukuna e mātou.
editorial.bodyHtml:
Our sources

We base our guides on public guidance from organizations such as the National Institute on Aging, the CDC, the Alzheimer’s Association, the Alzheimer’s Foundation of America, the Family Caregiver Alliance and the NHS, and on peer-reviewed research such as Cochrane reviews and large clinical trials. Every guide lists the sources it relies on. We open each source before citing it, and we only report what it actually says.

How we write

  • Practical first: what to do today, in plain language.
  • Honest about evidence: we say “linked with”, “may” and “the evidence is mixed” when that is the truth.
  • Respectful: we write about people living with dementia as adults, and we never use quizzing or shaming language.
  • No invented content: no made-up statistics, quotes, experts, studies, reviews or testimonials.

Who reviews our pages

Pages are written and checked by the Creative Activities team. Some drafting and research use AI tools, as described below. Every page is checked against its sources by the team. Our pages have not been reviewed by a doctor or other clinician, and we do not claim otherwise. They are general information, not medical advice.

How AI is used

We use AI tools to help with research, first drafts, translation drafts and formatting. A person edits every page against its sources. AI does not test activities: a person tries each activity before it is published. No AI-generated step, image or review is presented as verified, and we do not publish AI-written reviews or testimonials. No generated image is shown as a photo of a real activity.

What we will never publish

  • Claims that a game, food, supplement, fast or routine prevents, treats, slows or cures dementia.
  • Tests, quizzes or scores that suggest someone has, or does not have, dementia.
  • Advice to start, stop or change any medicine.
  • Advertising or sponsored content disguised as guidance.

Updates and corrections

Each page shows the date it was last updated. If you find a mistake or an out-of-date source, please email {email} and we will check it promptly.

faq.title: Ngā Pātai me ngā Whakautu
faq.seoTitle: Ngā Pātai me ngā Whakautu mō Creative Activities
faq.description: Ngā whakautu ki ngā pātai noa mō ngā tākaro me ngā mahi: ko ēhea ka whakamātau, he roa kia pēhea te tākaro, ngā rōpū me ngā whakaaro mō ngā wā i muri mai, hauora me te muna.
faq.lede: He whakautu poto, māmā ki ngā pātai e tino pātaia ana e ngā kaitiaki.

items.q: Ko ēhea ngā tākaro pai mō ngā kaumātua?
items.a: Ko ngā kēmu tino pai he mea mātatau, he māmā, kāore hoki he pēhanga, ā, ko te kēmu tika ko tērā e pai ana ki te tangata i tēnei rā tonu. He pai ki te tokomaha te whakarōpū whakaahua e kitea ana, te kōmaka, ngā panga māmā, te whakaoti kīwaha mātatau, te tā whakaahua, me te pingo whakaahua. Kaua e whakamahi i ngā matawā, ngā piro, me ngā mea katoa e rite ana ki te whakamātautau.

items.q: He kore utu tūturu ēnei kēmu?
items.a: Āe. He koreutu ngā kēmu katoa me ngā rauemi tā, kāore he pūkete, he rēhita, he tikiake, he pānuitanga rānei.

items.q: Why are there no scores, levels or timers?
items.a: Mā te tere me ngā kaute ka rite tētahi mahi ngahau ki tētahi whakamātautau, ā, ka puta pea he whakamā, he pōrearea rānei. Ko te aronga matua ko te ngahau me te wā noho tahi, nō reira kāore he mea e hinga ai koe, ā, ka taea e koe te whakamutu i ngā wā katoa.

items.q: Ko ēhea pūrere ngā mea tino pai ki te whakamahi?
items.a: Ahakoa he waea kōrero, he papa rorohiko, he rorohiko rānei e whai pūtirotiro ipurangi hou ana. He pai tonu te papa rorohiko ki runga tūnga i te tēpu mō te hunga tokorua e noho tahi ana ki te taha o tētahi ki tētahi. Mō ngā rōpū, he pai te hono i te pona rorohiko ki te pouaka whakaata.

items.q: Ka taea e mātou te tākaro mā te whakamahi i ā mātou ake whakaahua whānau?
items.a: Āe. Ka hurihia e Photo pairs ngā whakaahua e 2 ki te 6 ka tīpakohia e koe hei kēmu takirua. Ka noho tonu ngā whakaahua ki tō pūtirotiro, ā, kāore e tukuna ake, e tiakina rānei ki tētahi atu wāhi.

groups.title: Ngā mahi me te manaaki tangata

items.q: Kia pēhea te roa o tētahi mahi?
items.a: He maha ngā wā he nui tonu te 10 ki te 20 meneti, ā, i ētahi wā he tino pai ahakoa he 2 meneti noa iho. Titiro mēnā e ngenge ana, e pōrearea ana rānei rātou, ā, me whakamutu i te wā e pai tonu ana te noho. Kāore he roa tōtika.

items.q: Ka ahatia mēnā kāore rātou e hiahia ki te whai wāhi ki tētahi mahi?
items.a: Whakautehia tō rātou whakakāhoretanga, ā, whakamātau anō ā muri ake, mā tētahi atu huarahi rānei. Ka hua pea te whakakāhore i te ngenge, te mamae, te koretake o te mōhio, te kore hiahia rānei. Tirohia tā mātou aratohu mō te mahi ina kore rātou e hiahia.

items.q: He aha ngā mahi e tika ana mō te wāhanga matatau o te mate wareware?
items.a: Ko te whakamarie me ngā rongo: ko te whakarongo ki ngā waiata e tino manakohia ana, ko te mirimiri ringa ki te kirīmi, ko te tirotiro whakaahua ngātahi, ko te pupuri i tētahi paraikete ngohengohe, ko te noho ki waho, ko tētahi kēmu whakaahua māmā noa iho rānei me tētahi tangata e noho tahi ana i tōna taha. He maha atu ngā whakaaro kei roto i tā mātou aratohu mō ngā wāhanga matatau.

items.q: He mahi anō mō ngā rōpū kei roto i ngā kāinga manaaki?
items.a: Āe. Kei a Picture bingo ngā kāri hei tā me te kaikēmu ki te mata rorohiko, ā, he pai hoki te pānui ā-waha i ngā kēmu Finish the saying me ngā Conversation cards. Kei roto i tā mātou aratohu mō ngā rōpū kāinga manaaki ngā kōrero mō te rahi o te rōpū, te whakariterite nohoanga, me te whakahāngai mō ngā taumata āhei rerekē.

items.q: Ka taea rānei e ngā kēmu te ārai, te whakatōtā rānei i te mate wareware?
items.a: Kāore anō kia kitea he kēmu hei ārai i te mate wareware, ā, kāore hoki ā mātou kēmu e kī pērā ana. Kua kitea e ngā rangahau ētahi painga iti o te whakaohooho whakaaro i roto i ngā horopaki whakawhanaunga mō te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware māmā, tōtika noa iho rānei, engari he rerekē tērā i te kēmu hei ārai i te mate. Ka whakaratohia e mātou ēnei kēmu hei oranga ngākau, hei whakawhanaungatanga hoki.

items.q: Ka taea rānei te ārai i te mate wareware?
items.a: Kāore e tino taea te kī taurangi. Kua kitea e ngā rangahau he hononga kei waenga i ētahi āhuatanga hauora, momo noho hoki e 14 me te mōrea o te mate wareware, pērā i te turi, te pēhanga toto tiketike, te kore korikori tinana, me te noho mokemoke. Tērā pea ka whakaiti te whakatika i ēnei i te mōrea mō ētahi tāngata, engari he tokomaha tonu te hunga e whai ana i ngā huarahi tika katoa ka pāngia tonu e te mate wareware. Ehara rawa i te he nō tētahi.

items.q: He pai rānei te nohopuku wā poto mō te hauora o te roro?
items.a: He iti noa iho, he tōmua hoki ngā taunakitanga i roto i te tangata, ā, kei roto kē i ngā kararehe te nuinga o ngā rangahau. Ka noho mōrea pea te nohopuku mō ngā kaumātua, inā koa te hunga e tango rongoā ana mō te mate huka, te hunga rānei kua heke ohorere te taumaha, ā, kāore e tūtohua ana mō ngā tāngata e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware. Kōrero ki tētahi tākuta i mua i te panoni i tō kai.

items.q: E kohikohi ana koutou i ētahi pārongo?
items.a: Kāore he pūkete, kāore he pānuitanga. Ka whakamahi mātou i a Google Analytics hei tatau i ngā toronga me te kite ko ēhea whārangi e āwhina ana, ā, ka maumahara tō pūtirotiro mēnā i whakakāhia e koe ngā oro ngāwari. Kāore rawa ngā whakaahua ka kōwhiria e koe mō Photo pairs e tukuna ake. Tirohia te pānui tūmataitinga mō ngā taipitopito.
Kāo. He kaupapa whakangahau, he mōhiohio whānui noa iho a Creative Activities. Mō ngā pātai hauora, kōrero ki tētahi tākuta, ā, mō ngā ohorere waea atu ki te 111.

faq.moreHtml: Ētahi atu kōrero: me pēhea te tākaro tahi, ina kī mai rātou kāore, ngā mahi o te wā i muri mai me ngā mahi wareware i te kāinga.

handout.title: He Kēmu Koreutu, Ngāwari Hoki mā te Hunga e Noho Tahi ana me te Mate Wareware
handout.seoTitle: Pepa Tā hei Tohatoha: He Kēmu Mate Wareware Koreutu i te Ipurangi
handout.description: He pepa tā whārangi-tahi hei tohatoha mā ngā whānau me ngā kaitiaki mō ngā kēmu whakaahua koreutu, ngāwari hoki mā te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware, mō ngā rōpū tautoko me ngā pōkai manaaki.
handout.lede: Tāngia tēnei whārangi mō tētahi rōpū tautoko, pōkai manaaki, mō te tatau kāpata mātao rānei. Whakamahia te whakahau Tā o tō pūtirotiro; ka mahue atu ngā tahua me ngā pātene i te pepa tā.
handout.introHtml: He whakaahua nui, he kupu māmā, ā, kāore he mea hei hinganga māu. He koreutu i runga waea kōrero, papa rorohiko, rorohiko rānei, kāore he rēhita, kāore he pānuitanga, kāore he taima, kāore hoki he kaute. E noho tahataha, ka whakawhitiwhiti ai i ngā hurihanga.
handout.restHtml:
Ētahi tohutohu āwhina

  • Kōwhiria he wā o te rā e tino pai ana te noho a te tangata.
  • Tīmata ki te taumata māmā katoa. He nui tonu ngā tāpa e whā.
  • Kōrerorero mō ngā whakaahua. Ko te whakawhiti kōrero tonu te wāhanga pai rawa o te mahi.
  • Whakamutua i te wā e pai tonu ana te noho. He hua pai tonu te whakamutu wawe.

Ētahi atu mea kei te pae tukutuku

  • Ngā rauemi tā koreutu: he rapu kupu momotuhi nui, he whārangi whakakākahu tae, he kāri kōrerorero, he kēmu picture bingo hoki.
  • He whakaaro mahi mō ia wāhanga, me ngā aratohu mō te tākaro ngātahi me te manaaki i a koe anō.

Mō te ngahau me te noho tahi. Ehara i te tohutohu hauora, i te whakamātautau, i te maimoatanga rānei. Kua whakaputaina a Creative Activities e Cloudjet Solutions Pte. Ltd.

organizations.lede: He koreutu ngā mea katoa i tēnei pae tukutuku hei whakamahi mā ngā kainoho, ngā mema, me ngā kiritaki; kāore he kaute, he raihana, he utu rānei. E whakamārama ana tēnei whārangi i ngā mea kei konei me ngā huarahi hei tohatoha atu.

organizations.useTitle: Ngā mea ka taea e ngā whakahaere te whakamahi
organizations.gamesItemHtml: He kēmu pūtirotiro e {count} e mahi ana i runga pona, papa rorohiko, i tētahi pouaka whakaata rānei e tūhono ana ki te rorohiko. Kāore he whakauru pūmanawa, he kaute, he tikiake rānei. Tirohia ngā kēmu katoa.
organizations.printablesAfter: Whakamahia te pātene Tā kei ia whārangi.
organizations.moreItemsHtml:
• Momo rōpū: Kei te Pingo pikitia ngā kāri ka taea te tā me tētahi kaikāranga i runga i te mata, ā, kei te kēmu kōrerorero ngā pātai me ngā kōwhiringa whakautu me ngā take korero.
  • Aratohu mahi mō ngā kaimahi me ngā whānau, he reo māmā te tuhi me ngā takirangi. Tīmata ki 101 whakaaro mahi, ki ngā mahi rōpū mō ngā whare manaaki rānei.
organizations.restHtml:
Te whakamahi a ngā rōpū

  • Ngā whare tiaki me ngā ratonga mahara: he pīngo whakaahua, he whakaoti kīwaha rānei i te pouaka whakaata o te rūma noho tahi, mā tētahi tangata kotahi e pāpā te mata mō te rōpū.
  • Ngā hōtaka awatea mō te hunga pakeke: he wāhi papa rorohiko kei reira ngā Takirua whakaahua e whakatakotoria ana ki ngā tāpa e whā, mō ētahi wātaka poto takitahi.
  • Ngā whare pukapuka tūmatanui: he rapu kupu kua tāia me ngā kāri kōrerorero i roto i ngā kete mahara, ā, kua tohua hoki te pae tukutuku ki ngā papa rorohiko o te whare pukapuka.
  • Ngā rōpū tautoko kaitiaki me ngā kāwhe mahara: he puka toha whārangi-kotahi hei tā mā ngā whānau hei mau ki te kāinga.
  • Ngā hōhipera me ngā kaiwhakarite putanga: te puka toha i roto i ngā pōkai mā ngā kaitiaki, hei mahi marino ki te kāinga, ki te taha moenga rānei.

Ko ngā mea kāore e mahia e mātou

He mea hanga ngā kēmu mō te ngahau me te noho tahi noa iho. Kāore he mahi whakatau mate, he whakamātautau, he tapeke piro, he rongoā, he whakaroa rānei i te mate wareware, ā, e tono ana mātou kia kaua ngā whakahaere e whakaatu pērā i a rātou. Kāore kau he pānuitanga hokohoko, ā, kāore hoki ngā kēmu e tono ingoa, taipitopito hauora, whakaahua rānei kia tukuna ake. E whakamahi ana te pae tukutuku i a Google Analytics hei tatau i ngā toronga mai; e whakamārama ana tā mātou pānui tūmataiti i ngā mea e kohia ana. Ko ngā whakaahua ka whakamahia i roto i te Takirua whakaahua ka noho tonu ki te pūtirotiro.

Tāpirihia mai mātou ki tāu rārangi rauemi

Mēnā he rārangi rauemi tāu mā ngā kaitiaki, he pai noa iho te hono mai ki {domain}. Ka taea e koe te tārua i tētahi o ngā whakamārama.
organizations.linksHtml:
Ngā whārangi whai hua hei hono tika atu: ngā kēmu kore utu, ngā mea ka taea te tā kore utu, ngā mahi mate wareware i te kāinga me me pehea te tākaro tahi.

Ngā pātai, ngā whakatika rānei

Mēnā he hē, he māori rānei tētahi mea i runga i te paetukutuku, mēnā rānei kāore ngā mea kei konei e whakatutuki ana i ngā hiahia o tētahi kaiwhaiora, tēnā koa whakamōhio mai ki {email}. Tēnā koa kaua e tuku mai ngā kōrero whaiaro, hauora rānei mō ngā kaiwhaiora, ngā tāngata tautoko rānei.

app.title: Te Taupānga Creative Activities
app.seoTitle: The Creative Activities App for iPhone and Android
app.description: Te taupānga koreutu o Creative Activities: he whakarōpū whakaahua marino me ngā tāpa nunui e whā, ka noho tonu ngā whakaahua whānau ki tō pūrere, he pōkai whakaahua tuimotu, ā, kāore he kaute.
app.lede: Ngā mea katoa e paingia ana e koe i te pae tukutuku, i roto i tētahi taupānga e mahi ana i te wā tuimotu, ā, ka taea te whakamahi i ngā whakaahua whānau e kōwhiria ana e koe.
app.bodyHtml:
Tīmata paku noa

Tīmata ki ngā tāra nunui e whā me ngā whakaahua taunga. Waiho ngā whakaahua kia kitea tonutia, huna rānei ina wātea taua whakaaro. Kāore he matawā, he māka, he whiunga rānei i roto i te aratau ngāwari. Kōwhiria kia 4, 6, 8, 12 rānei ngā tāra.

Whakawhaiarotia

Kōwhiria ētahi whakaahua ā-whānau mā te kōwhiringa whakaahua a tō pūrere. Ka tiakina e te taupānga ētahi kape iti iho mō āna mahi. Kāore e tirotirohia tō kohinga whakaahua, kāore hoki e hurihia ō whakaahua tūturu, ā, ka taea te pupuri kia tae ki te 24 ngā whakaahua ki tētahi kohinga kotahi.

Mātakitaki tahi noa

Tirohia kia kotahi noa te whakaahua i ia wā. Mā ētahi kōrero akiaki (tē herea) e whakatenatena te whakawhiti kōrero, me te kore tono i tētahi kia maumahara ki ngā ingoa, kia tuku whakautu tika rānei. He nui noa iho te mātakitaki noa iho.

Whakamahia tuimotu i ngā wā whakahirahira

Kua whakaurua ngā whakaahua tīmata me ngā mōkī whakaahua e waru katoa ki roto i te taupānga. E mahi tonu ana ngā kape whakaahua i tikiakehia ahakoa tuimotu. Mēnā kei te iCloud anake ngā whakaahua tūturu e tiakina ana, tērā pea ka hiahiatia he hononga ipurangi ina kōwhiria.

Kāore he pūkete, kāore he tūmau tukutahi whakaahua

Ka noho tonu ngā kape whakaahua ā-whānau ki roto i te taupānga i runga i te pūrere. Ka taea te muku i ngā kape me te kore e mukua ngā whakaahua tūturu. Tērā pea ka uru ngā raraunga taupānga ki roto i ngā pūrua pūrere. Pānuitia te kaupapahere tūmataiti o te taupānga, ā, mā te āwhina mō te taupānga koe e ārahi i ia hipanga.
app.disclaimer: Kua hoahoatia a Creative Activities mō te whakangahau me te kōrerorero ngātahi. Kāore e tohu mate, kāore e rongoā, kāore e ārai, kāore hoki e whanganga i te mate wareware, i te mate Alzheimer rānei.

gamesIndex.title: Ngā Kēmu Kore Utu Hei Tākaro Tahi Ipurangi
gamesIndex.description: Ngā kēmu ipurangi kore utu mō ngā pakeke tau, whānau me ngā tāngata e noho ana me te mate wareware: takirua pikitia, tauwhiti māmā, whakarōpū, kīwaha, tā tae me te pingo. Kāore he rēhita, tāima, me ngā kaute.
gamesIndex.h1: Ngā Kēmu Ngāwari Hei Tākaro Tahi
gamesIndex.lede: E {count} ngā kēmu utukore hei tākaro tahi ki tō pūtirotiro. He whakaahua nunui, he kupu ngāwari, ā, kāore he mea e hinga ai te tangata: kāore he matawā, kāore he māka, kāore he rēhita.
gamesIndex.listName: Ngā kēmu ngāwari hei tākaro tahi
gamesIndex.byStageTitle: Te kōwhiri kēmu i runga i te taumata
gamesIndex.byStageLede: He tohutohu whānui noa iho ngā taumata. Whāia te mea e pārekareka ana ki te tangata, me te mea hoki e tau ana ki a ia i tēnei rā.
gamesIndex.gamesCol: Ngā kēmu e tika ana i te nuinga o te wā
gamesIndex.moreHtml: He whakaaro atu i tua atu i te mata: 101 whakaaro mahi, ngā mahi mate wareware i te kāinga me ngā mahi toi.

faq.q: Ko tēhea kēmu hei tīmatanga mā mātou?
faq.a: He tīmatanga marino te kēmu Takirua Whakaahua me ngā tāra e whā. Mēnā he taumaha te kōwhiri i waenga i ngā whakaahua, whakamāatauria te kēmu Rapua te Mea Ōrite me ngā whakaahua e rua. Mō tētahi rōpū, whakamāatauria te Pingo Whakaahua.

faq.q: E mahi ana anō ēnei kēmu i runga iPad, waea pūkoro rānei?
faq.a: Āe. Ka mahi ia kēmu i roto i te pūtirotiro i runga waea, papa rorohiko, rorohiko hoki, ā, ka whakanuia ngā whakaahua kia kapi ai te mata. I te nuinga o te wā, ko te papa rorohiko i runga tūnga te mea tino hāneanea mō ngā tāngata tokorua.

faq.q: He pai anō ēnei kēmu mō tētahi e whai mate Alzheimer ana?
faq.a: Āe. I hangaia mō te hunga e noho tahi ana me te mate wareware, tae atu ki te mate Alzheimer, koia te pūtake e kitea rawatia ana. Ka noho kitea tonutia ngā whakaahua, he torutoru noa ngā kōwhiringa, ā, kāore he matawā, he māka rānei, nā reira ka whirinaki kē ngā kēmu ki te mōhio ki ngā mea taunga, kaua ki te mahara ki ngā mea hōu.

faq.q: He kēmu mahara ēnei mō te hunga kaumātua?
faq.a: He kēmu takirua me ngā kēmu pikitia e tino pai ai te pakeke tau, engari kua hangaia kia kaua e whakamātau i te maharatanga: i roto i te Takirua pikitia ka noho tonu ngā pikitia ki runga mēnā kāore koe e kōwhiri i tētahi atu. Ka taea te whakangāwari atu i tētahi kēmu maharatanga mā te whakakore i te tāima me ngā kaute.

faq.q: He kēmu anō mō ngā rōpū i roto i te kāinga atawhai?
faq.a: Āe. Kei te Pingo Whakaahua ētahi kāri hei tā me tētahi kaiwhakataki i runga mata, ā, he pai te pānui ā-waha ki tētahi rōpū mō ngā kēmu Whakaotia te Kīwaha me ngā Kāri Whakawhiti Kōrero.

appFacts.requirements: iOS 15, i muri mai rānei; Android 7.0, i muri mai rānei
appFacts.summary: He taupānga utukore mō te iPhone, iPad me te Android me te taurite whakaahua ngāwari ki ngā tāra nunui e whā ki te tekau mā rua, te taurite me te mātakitaki tahi i ngā whakaahua ā-whānau e kōwhiria e koe, me ngā mōkī whakaahua e waru kei roto e mahi ana ahakoa kāore he ipurangi. Kāore he pūkete, he pānuitanga, he matawā, he māka rānei.
features: He taurite whakaahua ngāwari ki ngā tāra nunui e 4, e 6, e 8, e 12 rānei; ka kitea tonutia ngā whakaahua hāunga anō mēnā ka whiriwhiria kia hunaia
Ka tāia he kape o ngā whakaahua ā-whānau e kōwhiria e koe ki roto i te taupānga mō te taurite me te mātakitaki tahi
Mātakitaki tahi: he whakaahua kotahi i ia wā me ētahi kōrero akiaki (tē herea) mō te whakawhiti kōrero
E waru ngā mōkī whakaahua kei roto i te taupānga; e mahi tuimotu ana
No account, ads, in-app purchases, timer, score or penalty

faq.q: Kei a koe he taupānga mō ngā pakeke tau me ngā whānau?
faq.a: Āe. He utukore a Creative Activities (kua rārangitia hei "{storeName}") i runga i te App Store me te Google Play. He whakaatu i te taurite whakaahua ngāwari ki ngā tāra nunui, he kēmu me ngā whakaahua ā-whānau e kōwhiria e koe, me ētahi mōkī whakaahua e mahi tuimotu ana.

faq.q: He utukore anō te taupānga Creative Activities?
faq.a: Āe. He utukore te tikiake, kāore he pānuitanga, he pūkete, he hoko rānei i roto i te taupānga.

faq.q: E mahi tonu ana te taupānga me te kore ipurangi?
faq.a: Āe. Kua whakaurua ngā whakaahua tīmata me ngā mōkī whakaahua e waru katoa ki roto i te taupānga, ā, ka mahi tuimotu ngā whakaahua ā-whānau ina oti te kape ki roto i te taupānga. Mēnā kei te iCloud anake tētahi whakaahua e tiakina ana, tērā pea ka hiahiatia he hononga ina kōwhiria.

faq.q: Ka taea anō e mātou ā mātou ake whakaahua ā-whānau te whakamahi?
faq.a: Āe. Kōwhiria he whakaahua mā te kōwhiri whakaahua o tō pūrere. Ka pupuri te taupānga i ētahi tārua iti iho i runga i te pūrere mō āna ngohe, kāore e tukuake ki te ipurangi, ā, e kore rawa e panoni i ngā whakaahua taketake. Ka taea e koe te tango i aua tārua i ngā wā katoa.

faq.q: He taupānga whakapakari roro, he whakamātau mahara rānei tēnei?
faq.a: Kāo. He mea hanga a Creative Activities hei whakangahau, hei noho tahi hoki. Kāore ōna kaute, kāore hoki he whakamātau, ā, kāore e whakatau mate, e rongoā, e ārai, e whanganga rānei i te mate wareware, i te mate Alzheimer rānei.

faq.q: Ka mahi tēnei ki runga i ēhea pūrere?

gameFaqYes.q: He taupānga anō tō tēnei kēmu?
gameFaqYes.a: Āe. Kei te taupānga koreutu o Creative Activities mō te iPhone, iPad me te Android taua momo whōrite whakaahua māmā nei, ka taea te whakamahi i ngā whakaahua whānau e kōwhiria ana e koe, ā, ka mahi ahakoa kāore he hononga ipurangi. Kāore he pūkete, he pānuitanga, he kaute rānei.

gameFaqNo.q: He taupānga anō tō tēnei kēmu?
gameFaqNo.a: Kāore mō tēnei kēmu. Kei te taupānga koreutu o Creative Activities mō te iPhone, iPad me te Android he whōrite whakaahua māmā me ngā tāera rahi me ngā whakaahua whānau e kōwhiria ana e koe, ā, ka mahi ahakoa kāore he hononga ipurangi. E noho koreutu tonu ana tēnei kēmu i konei i tō pūtirotiro.

gamePage.newToPlayingHtml: Hou ki te tākaro me tētahi pakeke tau, me tētahi e noho ana me te mate wareware rānei? Pānuihia me pehea te tākaro kēmu tahi, tae atu ki te mea e tika ana te mahi mēnā ka ngoikore tō rātou hiahia.

print.heading: Tākaro ki te pepa
print.sameRules: He ōrite ngā ture o te putanga pepa ki te kēmu kei runga i te mata:
print.pageNote: He whārangi kotahi mō te A4 me te US Letter, pai ana i te pango me te mā. Putanga {date}.
print.islandNote: Ka tāia ngā mea kei runga i te mata i tēnei wā. Putanga {date}.
print.point: Ki runga i te pepa, tohua he pikitia kaua e pātō, kaua rānei e porowhita ki te pene. He huinga hou ia rārangi.
print.pointTarget: Ki runga i te pepa, kei te pouaka i te tīmatanga o ia rārangi te pikitia hei titiro. Tohua he pikitia kaua e pātō, kaua rānei e porowhita ki te pene.
print.halves: Ka tapahia ia pikitia ki waenga. Tārua he rārangi mai i ia haurua ki te taha mauī ki te haurua taha matau e tika ana, tohua rānei ki te maihao. Kāore he mea me tapahia.
print.grid: He nama tō ia tapawhā. Rapua taua nama i te kī, ka tā i te tapawhā ki te pene o taua tae. Pai ana atu tae hoki mēnā he tae kē koe e pai ana ki a koe. Kāore he mea me tapahia.
print.colors: Ka ingoa ia rārangi i tētahi tae. Tohua ia pikitia e tae ana ki taua tae, kaua rānei e porowhita ki te pene. He huinga hou ia rārangi.
print.dice: He huinga kiko tō ia rārangi. Kōwhiria tētahi rārangi, kaua rānei e tapahi ngā pikitia, ka tango tētahi ki te puranga, ka kōrero pūrākau mā te whakamahi i ēnei, i tētahi raupapa rānei. Ka taea e te tangata ki te pass.
print.words: Tapahia ngā kupu, kaua rānei e tārua he rārangi mai i ia kupu ki tana pikitia. Pānuihia ngā kupu kia rangona e te katoa i a koe e haere ana.
print.cards: Tapahia ngā kāri i ngā rārangi tōpū. Whakatakotoria ki runga tēpu kei runga ngā mata, kātahi ka rapu ngā takirua.
print.chain: Ki runga i te pepa, pānuihia ngā pikitia mai i te taha mauī ki te taha matau, kotahi i muri i tētahi. Ka kī ia tangata i tētahi rerenga kōrero mō ngā pikitia kua kitea, kātahi ka tohu ki te pikitia e whai ake nei. Ka taea e te tangata ki te pass.
print.sort: Tapahia ngā pikitia i ngā rārangi tōpū, kātahi ka whakauru ia tētahi ki te pouaka e tika ana mōna.
print.puzzle: Tapahia te pikitia nui i ngā rārangi tōpū ki ngā wāhanga e whā, ka whakakōwhiwhi. Whakawhitia e rua ngā wāhanga i te wā, kia oti ai te pikitia. Ko te pikitia iti te aratohu.
print.cutSafety: Ka taea e tētahi kaiāwhina te tapahi i mua i te tīmatanga. Whakanohoia ngā kutikuti ki muri.

reasons.photos: Kāore he putanga pepa. Ka whakamahi tēnei kēmu i ō ake whakaahua, ka noho ēnei ki tō pūtirotiro, kāore hoki e tukuna ki runga, nō reira kāore e taea e te paetukutuku te tā. Hei tākaro ki te pepa, tāia e rua ngā kape o ētahi whakaahua pai ki te kāinga, ka takirua ki runga tēpu.
reasons.paced: Kāore he putanga pepa. Ka whakatakoto te porowhita i te tere mārie, tōtika i runga i te mata, ā, kāore e taea e te whārangi kua tāia te mahi pērā, no reira he mahi kē tērā. He kōwhiringa tonu te whakatārewa mārie tahi me te kore mata.
reasons.turns: Kāore he putanga pepa mō tēnei kēmu. Hei rapu takirua ki runga tēpu, tāia ngā kāri pikitia o Takirua pikitia, ka whakawhiti huri ai i te tangata ki te whakahuri i ngā kāri.
reasons.screen: Ko tētahi tuhinga pepa kāore anō. He whakaahua tēnei hei titiro tahi i runga i te whakaaturanga; ka pēnei tonu te mahi ina whakanohoa he whakaahua pai, he kāri rānei ki runga i te tēpu.
reasons.wash: Kāore he tuhinga pepa. Ko te peita wai ki te pepa he whakaaro ōrite: he pīkaunga māku, he tae kotahi i te wā.
reasons.sayings: Kāore anō he tuhinga pepa. I runga pepa, ka kitea ngā mutunga katoa i te wā kotahi, ka ngaro te kaupapa ngāwari o "Whakaatu te mutunga". Pānuihia ngā whakataukī i runga i te whakaaturanga tahi, kia rua rānei ngā mea e mōhio ana koutou ki ētahi.
